# Love To Restore

> A comprehensive DIY resource for furniture restoration, painting projects, and finishing techniques using professional-grade materials and methods.

Love To Restore provides detailed guides for homeowners and DIY enthusiasts looking to restore and paint furniture and interior spaces. The site covers paint selection, application techniques, color theory, and advanced finishing methods including epoxy and UV resin work.

## Key Topics

- furniture restoration
- DIY painting
- paint colors
- paint finishes
- interior painting
- paint selection
- home improvement
- Sherwin Williams
- epoxy resin
- UV resin
- polishing techniques
- interior design
- outdoor furniture painting
- paint application tools

## Getting Started

- [Love To Restore](https://www.lovetorestore.com): Homepage for Love To Restore featuring DIY painting and furniture restoration guides

## Painting Guides

- [Paint - Love To Restore](https://www.lovetorestore.com/paint): Main paint guide covering colors, finishes, and DIY painting projects with Sherwin Williams
- [Paint Selection and Techniques](https://www.lovetorestore.com/page/2): Painting guide covering paint selection, tools, and techniques for interior and exterior projects
- [Kitchen Painting and Interior Design](https://www.lovetorestore.com/page/3): DIY guide for kitchen painting, color selection, and interior design restoration

## Advanced Finishing Techniques

- [Epoxy and UV Resin Guide](https://www.lovetorestore.com/page/25): Comprehensive epoxy and UV resin guide for DIY projects, jewelry, and polishing techniques
